description: Profile of an eSoccer (virtual football, EA FC) player: ELO rating and position in the league ranking, win rate, draws, goals scored and conceded per match, goals per match compared with the league, how many matches had 3, 4 or 5+ goals, current run of matches with 3+ goals (or 2 or fewer), recent form, latest matches with clubs, most frequent opponents and next scheduled match. Answers questions like "how is X playing", "X stats", "is X in form", "how many goals does X score", "who does X play most", "when does X play next". Same window as the Bettrails page: last 6 months when there are at least 15 matches, otherwise the whole career. May include a free sample of member data (active streaks). Statistics only: no odds, no betting advice.

language.description: Language of the bettrails.com links returned (normally the language of the conversation). Default: es.

league.description: League. If omitted, the league where the player has played most. gt = GTLeagues; adriatic = Adriatic League; valhalla = Valhalla League; valkyrie = Valkyrie League; ggleague = GG League; esportsbattle = EsportsBattle; erivals = eRivals; cyberlivearena = Cyber Live Arena; volta = EsportsBattle Volta.

player.description: Player nickname as on Bettrails (case does not matter).
